protocol.copyright: The pac tools. Private to them: pacland implements it, pacbar uses it.

description.summary: workspace buttons a window can be dropped on

protocol.description: A panel with workspace buttons tells the compositor where they are. While the user drags a window, the compositor highlights the button under the pointer and, on release over it, moves the window to that workspace. The panel gets no events: the compositor does the hit-testing, so nothing is exchanged while the pointer moves.

description.summary: where the button of a workspace is

request.description: The rectangle, in surface coordinates, where the button of a workspace (1 to 10, as in the names ext-workspace gives them) is drawn. It replaces the earlier one for that workspace; a width or height of 0 removes it. Dropping a window on the rectangle moves the window to that workspace of the surface's output. Call it again when the button moves.
